messages:
emma_sales: Customer (FinTrust) asking if our on-prem air-gapped POC can do rolling node-by-node upgrades with minimal downtime and what a POC hotfix SLA/pricing looks like. Also need explicit language for their security questionnaire about bundle signing and BYO KMS.

ryan_se: TL;DR: yes for rolling upgrades, but zero downtime depends on app topology and DB migration approach. Operator will orchestrate cordon->drain->update->uncordon across nodes when artifacts are present in local registry.

tara_eng: technical: we deliver signed minibundles (full) and delta bundles (patch layers + manifest mapping). Delta bundles are smaller but require stable content digests across the registry. If the registry rewrites digests we detect it in preflight and either produce a manifest-mapping or fall back to full minibundle. Recommend replicas >=2 for stateful services.

ops_liam: POC hotfix add-on: we can offer 48-hour emergency triage + signed delta/minibundle delivery + remote assist for the POC term as a monthly surcharge. If preflight finds registry rewriting, expect a small one-time verification fee for mapping/import (~1-2 hours). Exact numbers go into the quote.

emma_sales: they want a 2-sentence SOW blurb and a verification snippet for auditors.

ryan_se: SOW blurb: "Redwood will supply signed offline bundles and an operator to coordinate node-by-node rolling updates in air-gapped environments. High availability requires appropriate replica counts for stateful services; schema-changing DB migrations may require brief maintenance windows. Monthly security drops are provided for the POC and an optional 48-hour emergency hotfix add-on is available."

tara_eng: verification snippet for security questionnaire:
```
# on jumpbox after transfer
sha256sum bundle-2026-09-01.tar.gz
cosign verify-blob --signature bundle-2026-09-01.tar.gz.sig --key redwood-pub.pem bundle-2026-09-01.tar.gz
# import to local registry
ctr images import bundle-2026-09-01.tar.gz
# run preflight to detect digest rewriting
redwood-preflight --registry registry.local:5000 --check-digests
```

security-bot: Recommended answer for "bundle signing and key custody": "Bundles are produced with detached signatures (Notary v2 compatible). For POCs Redwood can sign with ephemeral keys; for production customers we support BYO KMS/HSM for signing and verification. Verification commands and manifest checksums are provided for auditors."

ops_liam: operational checklist to send customer: provide a jumpbox with SCP access, local registry endpoint or node image import method, confirm if registry preserves upstream digests, and indicate whether they want Redwood-managed POC signing or BYO keys. Also request a mirrored staging cluster to validate delta bundles before any production rollout.

emma_sales: I'll email FinTrust with the SOW blurb, pricing note for hotfix add-on, verification snippet, and the ops checklist. tagging @security-bot for the final questionnaire wording. :+1:

release-bot: bundle 2026-09-01-hotfix created by @tara_eng (sha256:beef1234...); detached signature uploaded.
